categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies PeerManagerImpl::SendMessages() in src/net_processing.cpp to extract discrete P2P message dispatch handlers.
categories.rationale: Decomposes the monolithic SendMessages() dispatch loop into per-message helper functions, improving code organization and reviewability. The author notes that the 500-line inline implementation made navigation, lock analysis, and review difficult, though the move-only restructuring introduces no functional or protocol changes.
